propositions: A disposition-closed child (duplicate, not_a_bug, escalated) with a live replacement link cannot produce a completion-verifier attestation because the close path exempts it, yet the certification path demands one, blocking the parent's signature with no honest remedy.

The close gate (transition_close.py) grants disposition closes an exemption that skips completion verification, but the certification path (llm/completion.py) does not honor this exemption and treats unsigned disposition closures as uncertified.

A disposition-closed child can only certify by deleting its replacement link or misclassifying its close class, since reopening and re-closing re-enter the same exemption branch and produce the same unsigned outcome.

The completion-verifier attestation for a disposition close must record the disposition class and replacement link without claiming a PASS completion that never occurred, preserving auditability between verified completions and bookkeeping dispositions.
The force-close guard must execute before the disposition branch to prevent --force-close from becoming a bypass for verified closure requirements on linked duplicates.
